messages.subject: Issue with MSStatsShiny
parts:
Dear all, 

I'm facing two bugs when launching MSStatShiny GUI. 

First, I do have this message :

messages.author: 13904eb0f06097b0
messages.subject: Re: Issue with MSStatsShiny
parts:
Hi Clem,

I think I know the issue in the Shiny platform. We added peptide level analysis and I think it is being auto selected by accident. I will work on implementing a bug fix.

I think the R version error is due to having duplicate features per condition/biorep/run. For example, there may be two GITYSVPIK peptides in the same condition/biorep/run. We fix this in our converters by taking the feature with the maximum intensity.

I hope this makes sense.

Devon
